text: Had a glass of water since lunch? Keep a jug on the table.
Half the plate in vegetables tonight: sukuma, dodo or cabbage all count.
A ten minute walk after dinner helps everyone sleep.
Swap one fried snack this week for roasted groundnuts.
Fruit for the school snack box: mango, banana or pineapple.
Beans twice this week: cheap, filling and full of fibre.
Stretch for five minutes before the morning rush.
Brown posho or millet keeps you full for longer.
